en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large wooden church with steep pitched roofs and tower spires, standing on a slightly elevated grassy hill surrounded by a wooden fence and trees. The architecture resembles a Scandinavian stave‑style church. Printed white text appears along the bottom edge with a serial number, the words "Vang. Parti ved Kappellet." and the photographer/publisher credit with a date.
